shell.notificationsEmptyBody: You'll hear from us when a post publishes or needs your attention.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.body: We sent a link to {email}. You'll need it to connect your Facebook Page.

home.subtitle: Your account is ready. Here's what you'll be able to do next.

assistant.title: AI Assistant
assistant.subtitle: Ask for a content plan, a post, or a change to your schedule.
assistant.emptyBody: Soon you'll be able to say "plan my next 7 days" and review what it writes, right here.

content.title: Content
content.subtitle: Every post you've drafted, approved or published.
content.emptyBody: Posts you write or generate will be listed here, with their status.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.subtitle: See what goes out, and when.
calendar.emptyBody: Scheduled posts will appear here by day, week or list.

create.title: Create post
create.subtitle: Write it yourself, or let the AI draft it for you.
create.emptyTitle: The composer is on its way
create.emptyBody: You'll write here, add an image, preview how it looks on Facebook and schedule it.

channels.title: Channels
channels.subtitle: The social accounts DPOST publishes to.
channels.emptyBody: Connect a Facebook Page to let DPOST publish for you. Instagram and others come later.

media.title: Media
media.subtitle: Images you upload, and images the AI creates.
media.emptyBody: Uploads and AI-generated images will be collected here, ready to reuse.

brand.title: Brand Brain
brand.subtitle: What the AI knows about your business.
brand.emptyBody: Tell DPOST about your business and it will write in your voice.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: How your published posts performed.
analytics.emptyBody: Once posts go out, you'll see reactions, comments and reach here.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Published posts, failures and things that need you.
notifications.emptyBody: We'll tell you when a post publishes, or if one needs your attention.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Your account, workspace and preferences.
settings.emptyBody: Account details, workspace preferences and your plan will be managed here.
